scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:tilde && node scripts/pack-sites.mjs
scripts.build:main: node scripts/tilde-release.mjs && tsc -b && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-server && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/contact-page.mjs && node scripts/note-page.mjs
scripts.build:tilde: SITE=tilde vite build --outDir dist-tilde && SITE=tilde vite build --ssr src/entry-server-tilde.tsx --outDir dist-server-tilde && SITE=tilde node scripts/prerender.mjs && SITE=tilde node scripts/contact-page.mjs && SITE=tilde node scripts/note-page.mjs
scripts.test: node --test services/contact/server.test.mjs src/contact/link.test.mjs src/note/link.test.mjs src/lib/arrival.test.mjs scripts/booth-copy.test.mjs scripts/booth-products.test.mjs scripts/leak-guard.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node --test src/contact/page.browser.test.mjs src/note/page.browser.test.mjs
